scope: Dedicated document renderer only; no discovery/status lifecycle changes

configuration.PROPERTYAIGENT_DOCUMENT_CHROMIUM: Optional trusted executable path; defaults to installed Playwright chromium executable. No credential.

concurrency: One document renderer per Python process; existing run_daily_councils/run_weekly document work is sequential. No global cross-service resource guarantee.
limitations: RSS and aggregate disk are sampled fail-closed bounds, not cgroup/kernel aggregate ceilings
Simultaneous loss of both trusted supervisors is not a demonstrated cleanup guarantee
Production topology and kernel capability validation remain unauthorised rollout prerequisites
preserved_boundaries: No P0-A or AH migration import
cleanup: Private file custodian shares original deadline; parent verifies postconditions after reaping before closed receipt and capacity release; failed postcondition quarantines capacity.
